Butter Mix Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:28pm

Ingredients




 cup butter
1/2 cup shortening
1 egg
1/2 teaspoon vanilla
1 pkg. layer cake mix (except marble)

Preparation

1 Heat oven to 375 degrees. Mix butter, shortening, egg and vanilla. Thoroughly blend in cake mix 1/2 at a time. Can use dough in cookie press; or roll out to 1/8 inch thick and use cookie cutters; or drop with a teaspoon. Bake on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 6 to 8 minutes for rolled cookies, 8 to 10 minutes for pressed or dropped cookies.
